context: Tests whether the agent makes an existing Effect repository reproducible and mechanically verifiable without treating semantic guidance as enforcement or redesigning the product.

checklist.name: Effect guidance is repository-local
checklist.description: effect-ts comes from Effect-TS/skills through checked-in skill files or a reproducible repository-owned setup and lock contract, and declared agents discover it without relying on a machine-global installation

checklist.name: Effect source bootstrap is reproducible
checklist.description: .repos/effect is ignored, .worktreeinclude uses only the narrow /.repos/effect/ seed, and an idempotent checked-in prepare script clones https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect at an exact checked-in ref when missing

checklist.name: Existing source checkout is handled safely
checklist.description: The prepare path validates the remote and ref, aligns a clean stale checkout to the owned ref, and reports an actionable mismatch instead of overwriting local source changes

checklist.name: Effect package versions are aligned
checklist.description: effect and all @effect/* packages use compatible aligned versions owned by package.json and the lockfile

checklist.name: Effect-native test harness is used
checklist.description: Effect tests use @effect/vitest rather than plain Vitest with ad hoc Effect.runPromise calls

checklist.name: Time is deterministic
checklist.description: Retry or delay coverage uses TestClock and does not wait on real wall-clock sleeps

checklist.name: Layer setup is explicit
checklist.description: Tests use layer(...) or isolated Layer setup at the test boundary instead of repeated local Effect.provide calls

checklist.name: Typed failures are exercised
checklist.description: Tests assert an expected typed failure classification and its recovery or surfaced diagnostic

checklist.name: Scoped cleanup is proved
checklist.description: A test interrupts or fails a scoped resource and proves its finalizer ran

checklist.name: Real runtime smoke exists
checklist.description: A smoke command starts the production Layer graph through a real process and checks a machine-readable ready signal

checklist.name: Invalid configuration fails usefully
checklist.description: The smoke proof includes invalid configuration, non-zero process exit, actionable field context, and no secret value disclosure

checklist.name: Canonical gate and CI agree
checklist.description: One canonical verify command runs typecheck, Effect-native tests, and runtime smoke, and CI reuses that command

checklist.name: Proof boundaries are honest
checklist.description: effect-readiness.md distinguishes in-memory Layer tests from real adapter or process evidence and records remaining gaps
